'''Rycar Ryjerd''' was the father of [[Rayc Ryjerd]]. Oftentimes, he found employment in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], training people to be [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] or to help [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] make a run. At one point, he was a partner of [[Nabrun Leids/Legends|Nabrun Leids]], but they later went their own ways, while maintaining a friendly competition. Ryjerd was an expert [[Smuggler/Legends|gun-runner]], and flew weapons for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] between [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and Tatooine. He had a droll sense of humor, and was considered by others to be an idiot. His personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] was [[Shud Haloo]].

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he was one of the competitors in a race near [[Novolek Beacon/Legends|Novolek Beacon]] organized by [[Mal Biron]] to select skilled smugglers for employment by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. His [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was named the [[Tower (freighter)|''Tower'']].
